kernel_family: loop-induced H->gg heavy-top effective proxy with NLO QCD coefficient
operator_attachment_required: Qa/SU3 color operator packet plus top/bottom/charm loop representation data
why_not_precision: This is a heavy-top effective proxy with an NLO QCD coefficient. It lacks exact mass-dependent loop functions, bottom/charm interference, higher-order QCD/EW corrections, threshold covariance, and selected Qa/SU3 operator data.
